messages:
anna.design: Quick design check — compact trace panel iteration. Proposal: collapse stack frames by default, show a sticky correlation ID header, and move Export actions into a small toolbar that's shown on hover or via keyboard. Thoughts?

kevin.pm: I'd prefer keeping a visible export affordance. Export is common during debugging — hiding it makes it less discoverable.

sam.engineer: Maybe combine: small visible export icon + kebab for advanced exports. For mobile, export goes into the overflow. Also we should add a keyboard shortcut (e) to export and another (c) to copy correlation ID.

raj.eng: Accessibility nits: collapsed frames must be true buttons with aria-expanded. Keyboard focus must be visible when navigating frames. Also current low-contrast dimming of collapsed frames fails AA in the color tests.

jen.qa: We also need permalinks to frames/span-level. Copying a frame permalink should include span id, e.g. /trace/12345?span=abcd — saves a lot of triage time.

anna.design: I made two mock variants in Figma: "compact-with-ids" and "full-with-actions". Link: https://figma.com/proto/placeholder (will update). Compact hides most actions but surfaces Copy ID.

sam.engineer: Decision matrix = frequency vs discoverability. Proposal: show primary actions (Copy ID, Export JSON) inline; put rarer actions (Export CSV, Export with metadata) in kebab menu.

kevin.pm: Copy tweak request: instead of generic "Download trace" use "Export trace JSON" so intent is explicit.

raj.eng: Keyboard behavior suggestion: when a trace row is focused, Enter opens the detail sidebar; Space toggles collapse/expand. Add role=button and tabindex=0 on rows.

anna.design: Agree. Also SR announcement: when collapsing say "X frames collapsed" for screen readers.

jen.qa: Edge case: very long stack frames need wrapping and selectable mono fonts. Add line numbers and a gutter for highlights so QA can point to a line in bug reports.

sam.engineer: Performance note: some traces render 2k frames. We'll need virtualization + placeholder collapsed summary rows to keep frames interactive.

kevin.pm: Can we add a "Copy all correlation IDs" action? Customers often need bulk IDs for correlating across systems.

anna.design: :thumbsup: I'll add that to the toolbar in the next Figma pass. UX question: should export actions be present in the compact view via a small persistent toolbar or only on hover? Keyboard-first users need it persistent/accessible.

design-bot: Design review scheduled: Thu 10:00am — agenda added to calendar.

raj.eng: Export content should include meta context: model, region, routing policy. Without that it's hard to reproduce customer environment.

sam.engineer: Agreed. Suggested JSON schema snippet for exported trace (for engineers to reference):
```
{
  "trace_id": "string",
  "correlation_ids": ["string"],
  "meta": { "model": "string", "region": "string", "routing": "string" },
  "spans": [ /* spans... */ ]
}
```

kevin.pm: Tooltips copy edits: "Share frame" -> "Copy frame permalink"; "Copy ID" -> "Copy correlation ID" (more explicit).

anna.design: I'll push updated Figma and annotate components with ARIA roles and keyboard flows. Tagging @sam for the perf constraints and @raj for a11y notes.

jen.qa: I'll run an a11y audit once the build has the new components. Also will test NVDA/VoiceOver announcements.

kevin.pm: One more ask — export should optionally include a short human-readable summary (first 3 frames) for quick triage in customer reports.

anna.design: Noted. I'll include an option: "Include summary" checkbox in Export modal. Thanks everyone — will iterate and post new mocks before the review.
